summary: Retest of the iteration 29 fixes, done with Playwright against the public URL at 375x667 using fresh browser contexts, plus backend pytest. The HIGH gate fix PASSES. Fresh install opening /sender?code=123456: /language -> Continue -> /welcome (Skip -> terms, both checks) -> Accept and enter -> /sender?code=123456. sender-code-input is prefilled with 123456 and the auto-call continues (status 'Code not found…', as expected because no headset is open). getUserMedia was never called while the user was still gated. /viewer, /contacts and /history opened directly on a fresh install also go language -> welcome -> the target screen. With language chosen but terms not accepted, /sender?code=654321 goes to /welcome first, then resumes /sender with 654321. A normal first launch at / still goes /language -> /welcome (3 steps) -> Home. home-language-button opens /language?from=home (button 'Save'), and Italiano + Save returns to Home in Italian. A reload stays on Home. A returning user goes straight to /sender with the code, with no gate screens shown. Plurals PASS in EN and IT: '1 call' / '1 chiamata', '4 calls' / '4 chiamate', '1 more call hidden.' / 'Un'altra chiamata nascosta.', 'You have 1 free call left this month.' / 'Ti resta 1 chiamata gratuita questo mese.', and the plural forms for 2 calls. The English viewer shows 'Waiting for a call.' /api/join lang=en has an English <title>, og:title and og:description; lang=it and the default are Italian; lang=fr returns 422. One remaining LOW issue: the language options still render no aria-checked on web.

minor.issue: The server-rendered <html lang> attribute stays 'it' even when lang=en; only the client-side JS changes it, based on navigator.language. This is cosmetic for crawlers and link previews. Reference: /app/backend/server.py:224-227, join.html:2

ui_bugs.issue: accessibilityState={{selected, checked}} is set, but react-native-web renders no aria-checked: the DOM shows only role=radio and tabindex=0, checked both before and after selection. Screen readers on web still cannot tell which language is selected. Fix: add aria-checked={on} (and aria-selected if wanted) to the Pressable, as the welcome.tsx Check component already does. Reference: app/language.tsx:49-50

action_items: LOW: app/language.tsx:46-51: add aria-checked={on} to each language option Pressable so web exposes the radio checked state.
Optional: in the /api/join lang=en branch, also replace '<html lang="it">' with lang="en".

Optional: on a gated fresh deep link, the target screen (e.g. sender) mounts for one frame before the layout redirect. It loads the /api/stage iframe but does not start the camera. To avoid this, render a spinner instead of <Stack> children until the gate decision is made, or redirect inside the target screens.
critical_code_review_comments: The gate in _layout.tsx works because child effects run before the parent's redirect effect, and the sender auto-call needs camReady. Verified: getUserMedia was not called while gated. A screen with side effects on mount that do not depend on async readiness could still fire once before the redirect. Keep this in mind for new screens.

gate.ts keeps the pending deep link in memory only. If the app is killed between /language and accepting the terms, the invite target is lost and the user lands on Home. This is acceptable but worth noting.
/legal is excluded from the gate, which is correct so the terms links work from welcome. It also means /legal can be opened directly without accepting the terms, which is fine.

success_rate.frontend: ~97% (all requested flows pass; 1 LOW a11y item still open)

seed_data_creation: No server data was created. Test state (lang_v1, terms_v1, pro_state, and call_history with TEST_ ids) was injected into localStorage of throwaway browser contexts only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use a fresh browser.new_context per scenario. Preset state with add_init_script guarded by sessionStorage, so router.replace and reloads do not reset it: lang_v1=JSON.stringify('en'|'it'), terms_v1='true', onboarded='true'. call_history and pro_state are JSON strings stored JSON.stringify'd. To check the gate without side effects, hook navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia in an init script. Screenshots: use a .jpg path (quality is not supported for png).
